notes: Theorem 3.2 covers p ≥ 2; §4 extends the result to 1 ≤ p < 2. For each time slack ε the guarantee uses a constant approximation factor depending on ε. The general-ℓp result is dated to v2; v1 on 11 May covered ℓ∞.

extra.norm: Any fixed ℓp, 1 ≤ p ≤ ∞; full-rank L ⊂ R^n
extra.approximation: γ(p,ε) = O_{p,ε}(1); not a fixed 1.97 or exact guarantee
extra.model: Classical randomized list sieve; polynomial input-size factors suppressed
